records.title: Prioritize per-anchor failures and friction; screen before paired evaluation.

Test HP3 autocal robustness to modest unpredictable friction and simulated sensor noise. Human priority is fewer failures across setups, accuracy, runtime, explanation. ANY anchor Euclidean placement error >20 mm is failure; EVERY anchor <5 mm is good. RMSE alone can hide failure. At most +20% collection effort is acceptable for substantially fewer large errors.

First audit and validate actual authored-to-baked-to-native friction/noise parameter paths. Report what type of friction the model represents. Use stock no-layering HP3, known 30 mm radii, zero buildup. Create isolated session-local USDA/harness inputs where stock configuration rejects variation, and verify they loaded. Keep truth out of fitting, force selection, seeds, stopping and evaluation-world policy tuning. Do not alter shared datasets or production physics. Rerun preflight on attached supervisor and command socket probe before long collection. Read recording-performance guidance, use native Rust, supported speedup 25, events routinely, no Viewer.

Within first 15 minutes obtain one current-code full-auto baseline result and at least one verified friction/noise perturbation result or explicit bounded failure. Then screen a declared small design, emphasizing asymmetric/per-route friction changes and plausible encoder noise. Define range assumptions, noise units, injection stage and fixed seeds. Distinguish sensor-read noise before averaging from offline perturbation. Target at least 4 independently configured worlds, with development and held-out evaluation split declared BEFORE policy testing. Preserve all failures, timeouts and partial outputs. If feasible try verified stiffness/layout variation after friction, but do not get trapped building general infrastructure.

After baseline screen, propose ONE simple bounded encoder-based force/measurement policy. Freeze it on development worlds, compare paired against current defaults on held-out worlds using matched seeds and initial conditions. Force is a command, not measured tension. Compare ordinary extra data versus deliberate force/reversal choices where relevant. Solver disagreement is optional diagnostic, not a mandatory detour. If force changes do not solve the failure, quantify that and identify the cheapest specific model/measurement correction. Do not default-switch solvers or disable physical guards. Favor a report-only negative result over an unvalidated patch, but implement a small supported collector/fitter change if the evidence warrants it and run relevant checks.

Report final APPLIED per-anchor A/B/C/D errors, maximum, RMSE definition, counts >20 mm and all <5 mm, per-iteration errors/tails/invalid fits, automatic acceptance separately from accuracy, sweeps/points, simulated seconds, steps, wall time, loaded scene/artifact/source hashes, input/noise seed identities and exact reproduction commands. Timeouts are workflow failures, never geometry successes. No hardware-transfer claim from a small sim sample.

Bounded budget: 100 worker minutes including research and report, up to 12 fresh collection jobs, 80 fresh fit invocations, 4 million steps and 8000 simulated seconds per live job, 48 million steps total, up to 4000 physical measurement points total. These numerical limits are explicit contracts; use supported per-job enforcement. Reserve last 10 minutes for summaries and cleanup. Start cheap; do not spend the whole budget before an informative result. Keep session research.md/report.md/abstract.md current and include small scripts, manifests and measurement JSON suitable for fixed evidence review. Return proposed exact scoped claim, selected evidence paths and any candidate commit. No automatic merge or push.

explanations.explanation: Force/measurement policy can handle varied friction and noise.
Systematic model bias or weak geometry defeats force adaptation alone.

blocked.observation: Execution/injection failure prevents valid calibration contrast.

counterexample.observation: Verified modest perturbations cause bad calibration that the tested reasonable force policy cannot recover.

improved.observation: Frozen policy reduces tested held-out large-error or workflow failures without added geometry failures and within 20% collection-time increase.

inconclusive.observation: Too little independent coverage or no observed failures to test failure reduction.

mixed.observation: Benefits and regressions or good accuracy without demonstrated large-error reduction.

checks.description: Reviewed the report HP3 friction/noise robustness screen and claim-a9ac9685183a4e3fb89ceff5a9664e8b at source revision 5bb8eb955fa680ddc631b6fb10f988ec3efb497a. Inspected manifest.json and the empty candidate.diff. All 32 submitted asset hashes match the manifest. This is a report-only submission with no production code candidate.

Traced the declared worlds, commands, effective 12-iteration override, fixed radii, zero buildup, native artifact and policy freeze. Rehashed the three embedded frozen policy sources and matched them to both v2 run invocations. The 09:44:12 freeze precedes the 10:03:13 eval0 start. The policy diff changes two preload paths plus import resolution. Inspected the generator and recorded byte-equivalence results; did not rerun generation or numerical jobs.

Parsed the exact applied M669 commands and independently recalculated Euclidean errors against the evaluator's full-precision authored truth. Maximum errors are 3.840677, 3.873242 and 4.349453 mm; anchor RMSE values are 3.284983, 3.319754 and 3.562306 mm. All match the saved measurements. Counted 140 points in each accepted dataset and recalculated nominal policy/default step ratio 0.9927558. These are arithmetic checks on saved data, not independent calibration reproduction.

Compared failure windows, partial-point evidence, manifests and hash-matched original collector logs. Active dev1 default has no points or fit; both development policy versions have 20 points and no fit; eval0 default has 40 points and no fit. Logs record encoder stability failures. Successful logs confirm spread-consensus stopping at iteration 5/12. Inspected severe 2693.972 and 2628.269 mm intermediate cold candidates separately from the final applied consensuses.

Inspected native readback of all nine guide coefficients, unchanged spool/motor settings, shared artifact identity and matched eval0 scene, noise sigma and seed. The posthoc noise-only control has zero native guide mu and normal acceptance. Zero-mu injection and unmodified nominal audits record the same complete first-step state hash. Saved native audits support the intervention distinction; no fresh audit was run.

Inspected probe construction, terminal snapshots and both saved native outputs. At 8 seconds the active probe has 53.494/53.353 mm local slack, zero local force and 0.0507058 Nm native load torque. Recalculated torque from transferred forces times 0.03 m radius, signed cable power 0.0133865 W, and rest/storage balances. Verified every source-map file hash and excerpt against git revision 5bb8eb955fa680ddc631b6fb10f988ec3efb497a. Source supports unconditional neighboring pinhole load transfer and the stated active-friction redistribution branch. No simulation, fit, exact replay or full energy audit was performed.

limitations: The evidence supports the tested simulation outcomes. It does not establish a hardware failure rate, calibrated hardware friction distribution or general robustness.
There is one completed nominal pair and one posthoc matched noise-only contrast. Adaptive workloads share a noise-stream prefix, not identical noise at identical physical times.
Held-out policy arms, eval1, wider friction ranges, layering, buildup and other machine configurations remain untested.

The probe reconstructs selected terminal fields with fresh hidden history. Terminal snapshots follow cleanup, and signed power samples omit terms required for a full energy balance. The complete causal model defect remains unresolved.
Independent work here checked saved-data arithmetic, hashes, commands and source. It did not independently reproduce the producer's numerical runs or reprocess every large raw sensor journal.

response.reason: Keep the unchanged report and evidence. Its scoped claim is supported: bounded preload preserved nominal final errors below 5 mm but failed to recover the tested development collection; matched zero-guide/noise-only collection succeeded; the constructed native probe demonstrates load torque with macroscopic local slack. The report distinguishes intermediate fits from final acceptance and states the remaining causal and hardware limits. No production change is proposed, so code adoption and engineering gates are outside this report-only verdict.

limitations: Support applies to the exact controlled partial claim. General superiority of lower force remains inconclusive: the nominal candidate failed and neither held-out evaluation calibration ran.

Calibration evidence covers two hypothetical HP3 worlds with one encoder-noise seed per world, known 30 mm radii, zero buildup, no layering and no guide friction. It does not establish hardware accuracy, reliability, failure-rate reduction or held-out motion prediction.

Adaptive workloads consume the matched noise stream at different physical times. The development result measures the resulting calibration workflow; it does not isolate equilibrium bias as the mechanism. Anchor A worsens slightly despite the lower maximum and RMSE.

The original transport delay and precise response latency remain unknown. A 5000 ms source cap is observable, but the delayed-response discriminator and transport fix were not tested. The nominal failure remains in the denominator.

This review recomputed saved geometry and consistency checks, not physics or fitting. The compact archive omits four full command/noise journals and supplies their full-archive references; I did not independently inspect or rehash those omitted journals.

Archived research harness imports use absolute worktree paths. Reproduction needs the documented path rebasing, recorded base, dependencies and native artifact; no production code candidate is supplied.
response.practical_value: Retain the partial as a useful local accuracy and effort result plus a preserved workflow failure. It supports keeping the production 5mid default and retaining the completed evidence for any bounded continuation, without repeating successful calibrations. Large intermediate errors also show why solver success or a fit score cannot replace final applied-geometry checks.
response.reason: Keep the exact report-only claim at a68d6adffec3aea86a55a17d6b4d65a27badd42a. Saved evidence supports three accepted calibrations with all applied anchor errors below 5 mm and a development maximum reduction from 3.6959 to 2.8529 mm at 1.0641 times simulated effort. The nominal candidate aborted on encoder transport before fitting, so the frozen no-new-failure condition did not pass. The report preserves that failure and intermediate tails, and correctly leaves evaluation and the transport intervention untested. These results support retaining the partial report and provide no basis to adopt a production force change. No additional check is needed to retain this scoped report.
